theorems.statement: ((∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid N) k) (τ : Fin k → Euclid N), Orthonormal ℝ τ → |α τ| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → (∀ (P k : ℕ) (W : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)), ∑' i, (W i).mass < ∞ → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), HasSum (fun i => W i ω) (S ω)) ∧ S.mass ≤ ∑' i, (W i).mass ∧ S.support ⊆ closure (⋃ i, (W i).support) ∧ ((∀ i, IsIntegerMultiplicity (W i)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity S)) → ∀ (N' k : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (H : Euclid (k + 1) → Euclid N') (A : Set (Euclid (k + 1))) (g : Euclid (k + 1) → ℤ), LipschitzWith L H → MeasurableSet A → Measurable g → IntegrableOn (fun u => (g u : ℝ)) A → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) (k + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) (k + 1), S ω = ∫ u in A, (g u : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') (k + 1)) (H u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ H u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))
